verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Bolna's homepage claim that it powers "thousands of inbound and outbound calls every minute", plus a one-line mention of scalable self-hosting on Docker or Kubernetes. No documentation of concurrency limits, per-account call caps, or self-serve scaling was found. missing for 10: documented concurrency limits per plan or account, a self-serve process for raising limits without contacting sales, independent or hands-on evidence of high-concurrency operation, and technical docs (beyond marketing copy) on how simultaneous-call scale is provisioned.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented concurrency limits and scale to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity begging

citations.quote: Power thousands of inbound and outbound calls every minute with human-like, multilingual intelligence
self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes for secure, private, and scalable enterprise deployments
